import sys

# Read the length of the array
n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())

# Initialize an array to store the elements
a = [0] * n

# Make n requests to find the sum of each pair of elements
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1, n):
        print(f"? {i + 1} {j + 1}")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        sum_ij = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
        a[i] += sum_ij
        a[j] += sum_ij

# Print the guessed array
print("! " + " ".join(map(str, a)))
sys.stdout.flush()
